# Disagreement Log — Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 8

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Chapter:** SHE 008 — Vision 2, Chapter 4
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

### 1. V. 1 — "all-powerful" vs. "almighty" vs. "almighty"
- **EMET:** "all-powerful and glorious Name"
- **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "almighty and glorious Name"
- **Decision:** "almighty and glorious Name" — pantokrator = almighty, standard patristic rendering

### 2. V. 5 — "blow hot and cold" — all three agree; idiom preserved
- Unanimous; noted as culturally resonant ancient idiom

### 3. V. 6 — "sons of lawlessness" vs. "thoroughly wicked" vs. "sons of lawlessness"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "sons of lawlessness" — Semitic idiom preserved
- **PNEUMA:** "the thoroughly wicked" — interprets the idiom
- **Decision:** "sons of lawlessness" — the Semitic idiom is preserved throughout Shepherd as a deliberate stylistic choice

### 4. V. 9 — "lustful ways of life" vs. "licentious way of life" vs. "lifestyle of lust"
- **EMET:** "lustful ways of life"
- **LOGOS:** "licentious way of life"
- **PNEUMA:** "lifestyle of lust"
- **Decision:** "licentious way of life" — "licentious" is accurate and appropriately formal

### 5. V. 10 — "true holiness of the truth" vs. "true holiness of the way of truth" vs. "full weight of holy living"
- **EMET:** "true holiness of the truth"
- **LOGOS:** "true holiness of the way of truth"
- **PNEUMA:** "full weight of holy living" — paraphrase
- **Decision:** "true holiness of the way of truth" — LOGOS adds "way of" which the Greek supports; the Way (hodos) is a technical term

### 6. V. 11 — Tower disappears: "I saw nothing of the tower, only the stones" vs. "the tower had disappeared, only the stones remained"
- **EMET:** "I saw nothing of the tower, only the stones upon the ground"
- **LOGOS:** "I saw nothing left of the tower — only the stones lying on the ground"
- **PNEUMA:** "the tower had disappeared" — slightly more interpretive
- **Decision:** SOPHIA follows LOGOS — "nothing left of the tower" is clear without interpreting the disappearance

**Total disagreements: 5**
